builds.name: Reference: Range and poke
builds.goal: Reference for Mel: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A repeated-hit mage who accumulates Overwhelm, uses a root zone to maintain hits and times Rebuttal against projectiles. Record Overwhelm stacks and reflected projectile type. A reflected spell is not arbitrary opponent damage you can always choose; compare real attacks/passive bolts separately. Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment.
testPlan: Kit question for Mel: Record Overwhelm stacks and reflected projectile type. A reflected spell is not arbitrary opponent damage you can always choose; compare real attacks/passive bolts separately.

Start with the early core (Luden, then Horizon) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Range-compatible spell hits test poke AP/penetration before a commitment. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Mel fires a barrage of projectiles that explode around a target location, dealing damage repeatedly to enemies within the area. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
